image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a lionfish (Pterois) resting on a textured, rocky seabed. The fish displays characteristic red and white vertical banding. Its most prominent features are the long, needle-like dorsal spines fanning out from its back and the large, fan-shaped pectoral fins with elongated rays extending to the sides. The head is visible with a dark eye, and the pelvic fins are partially visible beneath the body. There is faint, illegible text in the bottom right corner.
